tools.name: vulnerabilities
tools.description: Is this exact version of a package affected by known security advisories? Returns each vulnerability (with CVE ids and severity), the versions that fix it, and the smallest safe upgrade.

tools.description: What breaks, gets removed, is deprecated, or gains a security fix when upgrading one package between two versions, with an overall upgrade risk.
